issues: Primary is the 2026-27 booklet (the only one linked from the school site); the published doc is 'updated automatically every 5 minutes', so content can change. The PDF was exported from the underlying Drive doc 1M1S... (same title 'Course Catalog SY 2026-2027.docx' as the published doc); the published HTML is also saved as catalog_2026-27_published.html. 2025-26 copy saved as catalog_2025-26.pdf. The Drive doc IDs were found via search engine, not linked from an official page, though they carry CVU's title and match the published content. SU/SD: district calls itself 'Champlain Valley School District' (CVSD; legal name Champlain Valley Unified Union School District #56); schools.csv lists 'Champlain Valley Supervisory Union'. Treated as the same entity under different naming, so recorded as matching, but I could not confirm from an official source whether CVSD is formally an SU or a supervisory district — human check suggested.
